products.name: Vim Dishwashing Liquid
products.ingredientsText: Water, Sodium Laureth Sulfate (SLES), Sodium Dodecyl Benzene Sulfonate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Chloride, Lemon Extract / Fragrance, Preservative, pH Adjuster (e.g., Citric Acid), Dye

safetyInformation.skin_contact_warning: May cause irritation. Avoid prolonged contact with skin. [reference:2]
safetyInformation.eye_contact_warning: Causes serious eye irritation. If in eyes: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing. If eye irritation persists: Get medical advice/attention. [reference:3]
safetyInformation.ingestion_warning: Do not swallow. If swallowed, seek medical advice immediately and show the container or label. [reference:4]
safetyInformation.usage_instructions: Dilute 5–10 ml of Vim per liter of water. Dip a sponge or scrubber into the solution, apply to utensils, and rinse thoroughly with water. For heavy, dried food, pre-soak at a higher concentration. [reference:5]
precautions: Keep out of reach of children. [reference:6]
Avoid contact with eyes and skin. [reference:7]
Store in a cool, dry place in the original container. [reference:8]
Do not mix with other cleaning chemicals. [reference:9]
